note: upstream paths are guesses in the layout the current allowlist uses; the operator verifies each against a checkout before adding it to restricted/allowlist.json

components.name: Laser Flow
components.why: A shader scene that cannot be rebuilt in CSS, so it qualifies for the restricted allowlist next to Beams and Light Rays. It must render a static gradient frame when WebGL, lite or reduced motion says no. It overlaps Light Rays and Side Rays; pack only if the beam-on-surface look is asked for.
components.when: A laser beam that pours light onto a surface behind a hero title. One per screen as the hero motion of a launch or game landing; a flat gradient plate under lite and reduced motion.

components.name: Aero Shards
components.why: Worth packing: lit, folded 3D geometry moved by wind cannot be rebuilt honestly in CSS or Canvas 2D, and 'content-safe placements' means it is designed to sit behind copy. Distinct from the packed metallics (Liquid Chrome, Molten Metal) because it is discrete shards, not a fluid surface. Pack with pointer input off by default and a static poster frame.
components.when: A 3D field of folded foil shards drifting behind a landing or product hero; non-lite, one per app, flat plate under lite and reduced motion.

components.name: Beams
components.why: Already in the restricted artifact. Nothing to do beyond confirming the static poster frame and the lite plate in the catalog entry.
components.when: Crossing light ribbons behind a landing or product hero; compiled from the restricted artifact, non-lite, one per app.

components.name: CRT Warp
components.why: Low-priority candidate: plasma plus barrel warp plus bloom genuinely needs a shader, and a retro game-2d title screen is a legitimate use. But Faulty Terminal (packed) already owns the CRT look; take this only if the game-2d template wants a plasma screen rather than terminal squares. Disable pointer input in the pack.
components.when: A curved CRT plasma with scanlines and bloom for a retro game title screen; non-lite, one per app, flat frame under reduced motion, pointer part off.

components.name: Dither
components.why: Already in the restricted artifact. Keep the mouse-wave option off by default; a Bayer dither over a still gradient is the reduced-motion frame.
components.when: Retro dithered noise drifting behind a pixel-styled hero or 2D game; compiled from the restricted artifact, non-lite, one per app.

components.name: Faulty Terminal
components.why: Already in the restricted artifact. Keep mouseReact off; flicker must stop entirely under reduced motion, leaving the scanline grid as the still frame.
components.when: Flickering CRT terminal squares behind a status or retro game screen; compiled from the restricted artifact, non-lite, one per app.

components.name: Ferrofluid
components.why: Low-priority candidate: a fluid field with marching contour lines needs a shader, and the topographic look is distinct from Liquid Ether, Liquid Chrome and Molten Metal. Pack only with the magnet disabled by default (bind to touch-drag if kept) and a static contour frame for lite and reduced motion. If the pack list is tight, skip it: Liquid Ether already gives a fluid hero.
components.when: Churning fluid drawn as glowing contour lines behind a landing hero; non-lite, one per app, cursor magnet off or bound to a drag.

components.name: Galaxy
components.why: Already in the restricted artifact as @kit/restricted/galaxy. Its 'parallax' is pointer parallax, not scroll, so it does not break the nothing-moves-on-scroll rule. Freeze to one frame under reduced motion.
components.when: Twinkling starfield behind a launch countdown or night-event hero; one per app, aria-hidden, never under lite, with pointer parallax switched off.

components.name: Ghost Fibers
components.why: Genuinely needs a shader (recursive noise, radial twist, bloom), so not a build-original. Low-priority candidate: mood overlaps packed Silk and Beams; colors must map onto Air tokens. Must freeze to one frame under reduced motion and fall back to var(--canvas) under lite. Compiled-only via the restricted artifact, never in git. Renderer library (three vs ogl) is a guess.
components.when: Deep-blue twisting fiber field with glowing bands; a calm atmospheric backdrop for a landing hero or evening invite when the packed Silk and Beams feel too plain.

components.name: Grainient
components.why: Already packed as @kit/restricted/grainient. Under lite or the pixel theme use fancy/animated-gradient-with-svg rendered flat, or a plain token gradient. Freeze one frame under reduced motion.
components.when: Grainy swirling gradient with soft wave distortion; the packed painterly backdrop for a landing or store hero with one display line over it.

components.name: Iridescence
components.why: Already packed as @kit/restricted/iridescence. Map its color to var(--accent). Under reduced motion freeze one frame; under lite render nothing behind the panel.
components.when: Pearlescent shader with slow shifting waves; the packed glossy backdrop for a product or store hero that wants a material feel behind a single display line.

components.name: Light Rays
components.why: Already packed as @kit/restricted/light-rays. Keep followMouse off, set the origin to the top edge for the compact card, and freeze one frame under reduced motion.
components.when: Volumetric rays falling from a chosen edge; the packed backdrop for a confirmation or reveal hero where light from above is the only motion on the screen.

components.name: Lightfall
components.why: Overlaps packed Beams, Light Rays and Side Rays, so pack only if a template asks for a hyperspace look. Drop the cursor light on touch. The component does not check prefers-reduced-motion; the restricted wrapper must freeze one frame and force DPR 1.
components.when: A tunnel of colored light streaks raining toward the viewer; use once as the splash hero of a game-3d or launch screen when Beams and Light Rays feel too calm.

components.name: Liquid Chrome
components.why: Already in the restricted artifact. Tier A near-equivalent is libraries/metal-fx (liquid-metal plate with a flat fallback). No reduced-motion check inside; the wrapper freezes one frame.
components.when: A flowing chrome surface behind a hero word or product; import @kit/restricted/liquid-chrome for one non-lite hero, or reach for libraries/metal-fx when you need Tier A.

components.name: Liquid Ether
components.why: Already packed. Heaviest of this chunk (three plus a fluid sim, ~38 KiB source); pauses offscreen via IntersectionObserver. Force DPR 1 on phones and allow one instance per app.
components.when: Fluid color that swirls under a finger and drifts on its own; import @kit/restricted/liquid-ether for a non-lite landing hero that invites a touch.

components.name: Molten Metal
components.why: Already packed. Pauses offscreen via IntersectionObserver; no reduced-motion check inside, so the wrapper freezes a frame.
components.when: Molten plasma filaments with white-hot cores; import @kit/restricted/molten-metal for a dramatic non-lite game or launch hero, one per app.

components.name: Plasma Wave
components.why: Needs a shader, so it cannot be rebuilt, but it sits close to packed Molten Metal, Silk and Liquid Ether. Low-priority candidate; raymarching is costly on phone GPUs, so force DPR 1. No reduced-motion check inside.
components.when: Raymarched plasma sheets with two interfering waves; a non-lite hero for a game-3d or launch screen when Molten Metal and Silk are already spoken for.

components.name: Prism
components.why: Already packed. Pauses offscreen via IntersectionObserver; use its rotate mode, not hover, on phones.
components.when: A rotating glass prism throwing colored light; import @kit/restricted/prism as the one non-lite hero of a landing or store screen.

components.name: Side Rays
components.why: Already one of the 13 compiled-only React Bits backgrounds. Import from the restricted artifact only; it never lives in git. Sibling of Light Rays, pick one per app. One hero motion per screen means nothing else animates on the same screen.
components.when: Light rays fanning in from one edge behind a hero word or product shot; already packed as @kit/restricted/side-rays, non-lite, flat plate when off.

components.name: Silk
components.why: Already one of the 13 compiled-only React Bits backgrounds. Heaviest of the packed set because it drags in three and r3f; budget for it and use only one three-based plate per app. Under the pixel theme the flat fallback should read as var(--canvas), not a hard-coded color.
components.when: Slow silk-like waves with soft lighting behind a hero; already packed as @kit/restricted/silk, non-lite, renders a flat gradient when WebGL is off.

components.name: Morph Slider
components.why: A melt/displacement between images cannot be rebuilt well without a shader, and a photo hero for a store or landing is a legitimate mini-app use, so it earns a restricted-allowlist slot. Must ship with the same fallback contract as AirMetalFx: lite, reduced motion or no WebGL renders the current image as a still with a CSS crossfade. Images come from the bundle, not a host. fancy/simple-carousel stays the gallery default; this is the one-per-screen hero variant.
components.when: Hero image slider that melts one photo into the next through a displacement shader; one per landing or product hero, a plain crossfade or still under lite.
